final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate_usd FROM fees WHERE orderslink IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate_rate) AS avg_rebate_rate FROM per_order) SELECT p.orderslink, p.avg_rebate_rate, p.avg_rebate_usd, p.avg_rebate_rate - o.avg_rebate_rate AS rate_difference FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_rebate_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rate_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
